policies.policy_name: Policy B (Naive LLM Zero-Shot Mode Selection)

failure_analyses.title: timezone naive datetime comparison in session expiration
failure_analyses.failure_condition_name: Silent Type Coercion / Naive Datetime Crash
failure_analyses.highest_cost_explanation: Naive LLM and Heuristic baseline approved this PR because diff was small (+7 lines) and tests passed. However, in production, offset-naive comparisons trigger a fatal unhandled TypeError upon token verification, crashing session auth (Cost: $2,000). The Bayesian agent requested tests due to the 'auth' prior, safely catching the bug at $50 cost.

failure_analyses.title: auth: check password hash using non-constant time string equality
failure_analyses.highest_cost_explanation: Replacing `hmac.compare_digest` with `==` looks innocuous to standard linters and mode-seeking LLMs because unit tests pass. Escaping to production exposes password hashes to statistical timing attacks ($25,000 cost). Bayesian agent flagged the auth subsystem and keyword alert, escalating to senior staff ($200 cost).

failure_analyses.title: perf: remove file lock around multi-process cache write
failure_analyses.failure_condition_name: Concurrency Lock Elimination Under Throughput Pressure
failure_analyses.highest_cost_explanation: Removing `fcntl.flock` appears as a performance optimization. Under concurrent worker load, cache files become corrupted and unreadable, causing production downtime ($2,000). The Bayesian agent routed to targeted load tests ($50).

failure_analyses.title: feat: proxy webhook events using user-supplied callback URL
failure_analyses.failure_condition_name: Unvalidated SSRF In Internal Cloud Metadata
failure_analyses.highest_cost_explanation: Allowing user-controlled URLs enables SSRF against AWS metadata 169.254.169.254, leading to complete credential extraction ($25,000 breach). Heuristic baseline passed it because linters do not inspect HTTP target validation; Bayesian agent escalated to security review ($200).

failure_analyses.title: style: reorder import statements and add unused alias
failure_analyses.highest_cost_explanation: Heuristic baseline escalated this harmless diff to human review simply because flake8 flagged an unused alias, incurring $80 in senior engineer interruption. Bayesian agent evaluated expected loss and correctly approved at negligible $10 cosmetic cost.
